about.intro_content: Prof. Rong-Ping Guo is Professor, PhD Supervisor and Vice-Director of the Department of Hepatobiliary Tumor at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou. He has focused on hepatobiliary tumour research and treatment since 1988.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Guo leads a research team specialising in the diagnosis and treatment of hepatobiliary tumours, including surgery, vascular intervention, local ablation, targeted therapy and liver transplantation, with particular expertise in multidisciplinary treatment for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. He completed visiting fellowships at Queen Mary Hospital and Prince of Wales Hospital in Hong Kong, and at the Organ Transplantation Center of the University of Pittsburgh, USA. His research, supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, spans tumorigenesis, angiogenesis and metastasis of hepatocellular carcinoma.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Rong-Ping Guo

items.question: Does Prof. Rong-Ping Guo accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to liver cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Guo's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Guo specialises in the multidisciplinary diagnosis and treatment of hepatobiliary tumours, particularly advanced hepatocellular carcinoma, combining surgery, vascular intervention, ablation and targeted therapy.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Does Prof. Guo treat recurrent hepatocellular carcinoma?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Guo has published comparative research on treatment strategies for recurrent HCC, including repeat hepatic resection versus radiofrequency ablation.

items.question: What treatment options does Prof. Guo offer for advanced liver cancer?
items.answer: Prof. Guo's team offers a combination of surgery, transarterial chemoembolisation, local ablation, targeted therapy and liver transplantation, tailored to the stage and characteristics of the tumour.
